input: Find rock climbing, mountain biking, BMX and skateboarding camps for kids for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville climbing mountain bike skateboard summer camps 2026
site:fallingcreek.com rock climbing mountain biking dates 2027

candidates.name: Cultivate Climbing
candidates.note: Weeklong indoor climbing and bouldering camps for ages 6–14.

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: Adventure and Kolo mountain-bike camps; also operates KidCycle Club bike camps.

candidates.name: PUSH Skate Camp
candidates.note: Skateboarding instruction at Asheville Skatepark, including summer half-day sessions and skateboard art activities.

candidates.name: Fiddlehead Farm & Forest
candidates.note: Dual-sport summer camp combines climbing, biking and outdoor activities.

candidates.name: MTB Skills Factory
candidates.note: Youth mountain-bike summer camps in DuPont State Forest; July 2026 sessions advertised.

candidates.name: Pisgah Climbing School
candidates.note: Summer youth climbing instruction; July 2026 participants finished with a Looking Glass climbing trip.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Day and overnight summer programs, including mountain-bike instruction and off-campus trail riding.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys ages 7–16; overnight sessions with rock-climbing and mountain-bike instruction; 2027 registration open.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Coed overnight camp; mountain biking in Main Camp and Mountainside, plus climbing activities.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Boys ages 6–17; overnight camp with mountain biking and rock climbing; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Girls ages 6–17; overnight camp includes mountain biking, BMX bikes for younger riders and rock climbing.

candidates.name: Camp Carolina
candidates.note: Boys' overnight camp with rock climbing, mountain biking and mountain boarding trips.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys' overnight camp with progressive rock-climbing and mountain-bike trips, from introductory to advanced.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Girls ages 6–16; overnight summer camp with rock climbing among its adventure activities.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Coed overnight camp with mountain biking, pump-track riding and flow trails documented in summer 2026.

candidates.name: SOAR
candidates.note: Adventure camps for youth with ADHD or learning differences; North Carolina programs include rock climbing.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Boys' overnight summer sessions with rock-climbing and mountain-bike instruction and trips.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Boys' overnight summer camp; 2026 programs included mountain biking, pump-track skills and climbing trips.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls' overnight summer camp with climbing and mountain-bike instruction and off-campus trips.

candidates.name: Eagle's Nest Foundation
candidates.note: Eagle's Nest Camp offers coed overnight sessions with rock climbing; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls' overnight camp with climbing instruction and natural-rock trips in Pisgah; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish coed overnight camp for ages 6–16; mountain biking and rock climbing with nearby outdoor trips.

candidates.name: Camps Kahdalea and Chosatonga
candidates.note: Girls' and boys' overnight camps with rock climbing and mountain biking documented in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Girls ages 7–17; overnight camp with rock climbing and an on-campus climbing tower.

candidates.name: Ridge Haven
candidates.note: Christian summer camps; junior-high programming includes climbing, ropes courses and hiking.

candidates.name: North Carolina Outward Bound School
candidates.note: Teen Blue Ridge backpacking and rock-climbing expeditions in Western North Carolina, including summer 2026 courses.
